title: Mede's Game Tweaks
description: Makes changes to the game, without adding new items, blocks or enchantments.
body:
# Mede's Game Tweaks

## What is it about?
Mede's Game Tweaks's goal is to make minecraft more fun and make some items more usefull,\
without adding any new items, blocks or enchantments!

## Current features:

### Enchantment Tweaks:
- Unbreaking is removed
- Mending is removed
- Loyalty is removed
- Breach is max lvl 2
- Density is max lvl 3
- Sharpness is max lvl 4
- Protection is max lvl 3
- Riptide is slightly nerfed
- Infinity works on crossbows now (but only for arrows)
- Quick charge is now lvl 1 but more rare and does the same as lvl 2

### Trident Tweaks:
- Tridents Can now have Sharpness
- Always have loyalty build-in
- Will now always return to the correct slot
- Tridents Can now be "bound" to a player using a nautilus shell (Just like sincere loyalty from [Impaled](https://modrinth.com/mod/impaled))
- Channeling now deals damage to nearby mobs (has more range in water or rain and more damage with sharpness)

### Item Tweaks:
- Durability is removed
- Wind charges now have a longer cooldown
- Conduits now only cost 4 nautilus shells
- Default item pickup delay is now 15 ticks instead of 40
- Turtle Shells now give 20 seconds of water breathing instead of 10

### Anvil buff (might change soon):
- Anvils Can now apply either Protection 2, Sharpness 2 or Efficiency 3 by dropping an unenchanted item and a sculk catalyst onto it,
this will enchant the item and further the broken-ness of the anvil, and at the "damaged" state, it will break the anvil.

### Other Tweaks:
- The mace does Area of Effect damage now
- Drowned now have a 50% chance to drop their mainhand item
- Mobs now have extra Melee reach depending on difficulty (wolves even more)
- Turtle Scutes(150%) and Nautilus Shells(10%) can now be found in buried treasure
